title: Luther's Pontoon, Waverunners, & Kayaks Rentals

services.name: 20ft Pontoon
services.desc: Our 20-foot Pontoon Boat rental is the perfect economy boat for smaller groups and families. We only have one 20-foot & this boat books up fast, so be sure to make a reservation early! Can carry up to 7 passengers* or up to 1525 lbs. combined, whichever comes first. Driver must have boating experience, as our harbor & waterways are very busy. If driver has no experience, we recommend hiring a captain or booking a chartered captained trip through another vendor. Please note, the primary driver must be at least 18 years old, have a valid ID, cell phone, & credit card.
